standouts.head: MACD positive
standouts.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram falling.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.

against.head: Buying is losing force
against.text: A higher high in price (Nov 5) against a lower high in momentum (4 of 7 gauges): regular bearish divergence.
against.learn: Higher price highs with falling momentum highs: buyers are tiring.

against.head: Stretched above its 50-day
against.text: 4.3 ATR over the 50-day average (+17% away), among its widest gaps of the year.
against.learn: How far price sits from its 50-day average in ATR; far stretches tend to pause or snap back.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.

material.head: A bull flag
material.text: It ran +25% in 5 sessions, then drifted for 5 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 30% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.
material.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.

material.head: Support −5.6% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −5.6% below (1.7 ATR), where 4 levels (3 kinds) meet: the September breakout level, the 38.2% retracement of the Sep 29–Nov 5 rise and the 20-day average.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Back above its averages
material.text: Price has climbed back above both its 50-day and 200-day averages.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.
